lines: 水兰中学外，小雨淅沥沥的下着。
校门外，挤满了撑着雨伞的家长，他们被雨水淋湿的脸上满是期望。
今天可是他们孩子的升学大事啊，能不能上天澜魔法高中，能不能将来考上一个好大学就看孩子今日的表现了！
你没看错。
就是魔法高中！
这个社会，魔法为尊！
所有的孩子都需要接受九年义务魔法教育，学完九年魔法基础理论与魔法生活技能之后，都将接受和中考一样的考试，考试过的人，才能够进入魔法高中，成为一名真正的魔法师！
桂花被雨水打落在校园笔直的道路上，铃声响起之后，学生们蜂拥而出，要么独行，要么寻找着自己的小伙伴，讨论着今日的考试内容。
“喂，慕白，元素魔法的七系，冰系、火系、土系、水系、风系、光系、雷系，这道题你们做出来了吗？”一名戴着小领结的白脸男生问道。
“完美解答！”那个无论是发型、身高、长相都堪称男神的慕白说道。
“不愧是我们的尖子生，这么难的混系问题都能够做出来……咦，那不是模拟考上只靠了个6分的莫凡吗？”满脸麻子的赵坤三说道。
男神慕白眼睛马上不屑的瞥了一眼那个独自一人打伞的少年，道：“这家伙马上要跟他老爸一样，当一个破皮卡车采购员了。”
“那不就是你们穆家的仆人了吗，哈哈哈！”
这三人说话很放肆，根本就不怕旁边的那个叫做莫凡的少年听见。
嘲笑完之后，这三人自顾大摇大摆的离开了，显然他们有足够的信心能够考上魔法高中。
打着一把黑色的黄飞鸿伞，莫凡自顾走出了校门外去。
回头望了一眼这个即将告别的校园，莫凡千言万语化作两个字：坑爹！
能不坑爹吗？
莫凡本来不属于这个世界，他是一个天才学生，对平日里的考试其实压根不屑，从来都是交白卷。
被同学、老师们认为是学渣很正常，就像一个大学生没有理由要为了那小红花而浪费一个多小时时间在那里干坐着。
原本，莫凡就打算中考的时候再稍稍认真点，随随便便拿个全校第一、第二，用最打脸的姿态踩着慕白那种傻x到全城最好的高中……
谁知意外发生了。
自己一个大好学生，在学校后山睡了一觉，尼玛忽然间跑到了这个世界来！
魔法！！
身边的同学、老师、老爹、妹妹都没有变，尼玛变得是整个世界。
自己那崇尚科学的世界，在自己一觉醒来变成了魔法为尊。
神马数理化，变成了黑魔法、白魔法、异次元魔法！
神马学系，变成了火系冰系大雷系！
你变就变吧，莫凡其实一点都不抵触这魔法，甚至知道魔法真正存在，整个人都斯巴达了，偏偏就要在自己快考试的时候世界大变。
搞得自己对魔法知识一窍不通！
于是，从一个想要扮猪吃虎的学神一下子变成了真学渣，受尽了嘲讽、耻笑啊！
唯一值得庆幸的是：这九年义务魔法，学的都是一些杂七杂八的理论知识，只是一些魔法与生活息息相关的东西，真正的魔法要到高中才会接触。
成为真正的魔法师，必须经过一个重要的步骤，那就是“魔法觉醒”！
魔法觉醒会在高中开学典礼上，全校领导老师见证下开启，那个时候哪怕你前面的理论没有学，一样是有可能开启属于自己的系！
莫凡其实是真的喜欢魔法，这对他来说无疑是一次完美的奇幻重生。
他也想要成为一个能够傲立高楼穹顶上方舞火唤雷的至高法师，为拯救世界做那么一点贡献。
content_en:
Outside Shuilan Middle School, light rain was falling.
Outside the school gate, parents were crowded with parents holding umbrellas, their rain-soaked faces full of expectations.
Today is a major event for their children to go to school. Whether they can go to Tianlan Magic High School and whether they can be admitted to a good university in the future depends on their children's performance today!
You read that right.
It's Magic High School!
In this society, magic is respected!
All children need to receive nine years of compulsory magic education. After learning nine years of basic magic theory and magic life skills, they will take the same exam as the high school entrance examination. Only those who pass the exam can enter the magic high school and become a real magician!
…
The sweet-scented osmanthus was knocked down by the rain on the straight road of the campus. After the bell rang, students swarmed out, either walking alone or looking for their friends to discuss today's exam content.
"Hey, Mu Bai, have you finished the question of the seven elements of magic, ice, fire, earth, water, wind, light, and thunder?" asked a white-faced boy wearing a small bow tie.
"Perfect answer!" said Mu Bai, who can be called a male god in terms of hairstyle, height, and appearance.
"As expected of our top student, he was able to solve such difficult mixed-system questions... Hey, isn't that Mo Fan who only got 6 points in the mock exam?" Zhao Kunsan said with a pockmarked face.
The male idol Mu Bai immediately glanced at the young man holding an umbrella alone with disdain and said, "This guy is going to be a pickup truck buyer like his dad."
"Isn't that the servant of your Mu family, hahaha!"
These three people spoke very freely, and they were not afraid that the young man named Mo Fan next to them would hear them.
After laughing at each other, the three people left in a swaggering manner. It was obvious that they were confident enough to be admitted to the Magic High School.
…
Holding a black Huang Feihong umbrella, Mo Fan walked out of the school gate.
Looking back at the campus where he was about to say goodbye, Mo Fan's thousands of words turned into two words: cheating!
Can you not cheat your father?
Mo Fan didn't belong to this world. He was a genius student who didn't even bother taking exams. He always turned in blank papers.
It is normal to be considered a scumbag by classmates and teachers, just like a college student has no reason to waste more than an hour sitting there just for that little red flower.
Originally, Mo Fan planned to be a little more serious during the high school entrance examination, casually take first or second place in the school, and use the most shameless attitude to step on Mu Bai's stupidity to get to the best high school in the city...
Who knows an accident happened.
I was a good student, and after sleeping in the back of the school, I suddenly came to this world!
magic! !
The classmates, teachers, father, and sister around me have not changed, and Nima has become the whole world.
His world that respected science turned into one dominated by magic when he woke up.
Mathematics, physics and chemistry turned into black magic, white magic, and extra-dimensional magic!
The Shenma Department has become the fire, ice, and thunder system!
Just change. Mo Fan actually doesn't resist this magic at all. He even knows that magic really exists. He is completely Spartan, but the world is about to change when he is about to take the exam.
Make yourself ignorant of magic knowledge!
As a result, he suddenly changed from a god of learning who wanted to pretend to be a pig to a real scumbag, and suffered all the ridicule and ridicule!
The only good thing is that in these nine years of voluntary magic, I have only learned some miscellaneous theoretical knowledge, just some things that are closely related to magic and life. Real magic will not be exposed until high school.
To become a true magician, you must go through an important step, which is "magic awakening"!
The Magic Awakening Conference begins at the high school opening ceremony, witnessed by all the school leaders and teachers. At that time, even if you have not learned the previous theories, it is still possible to open your own department!
Mo Fan actually really likes magic, and this is undoubtedly a perfect fantasy rebirth for him.
He also wants to become a supreme mage who can stand proudly on the dome of a tall building, dance with fire and call thunder, and make some contribution to saving the world.
